video_caption: The video segment is an exploration of AI interactions, where the narrator prompts "Perplexity AI" with "If you were an animal, what species would you belong to and what would you look like?" The video begins with a woman with blonde hair, who looks out of a technological-looking circular mirror, set in an old stone wall. Text to the right of the screen reads, “I played the what if game with the AI Perplexity. Then, I had its responses illustrated by AI image generators. I didn’t change a single word in these responses in the prompts given to the AI image generators.” It transitions to a white, human-faced robot, and then to a title screen, that reads "Perplexity Answers." The image on the right of the screen shows a photo of a beautiful snow leopard in its natural snowy mountain habitat. The narrator, illustrated on the left by the robot, speaks on behalf of "Perplexity AI" and responds that it would belong to the species of a snow leopard and describe its features as majestic with thick fur, patterned with beautiful rosettes that blend into the snowy mountain landscapes, as well as its piercing eyes that reflect intelligence and a strong, independent spirit.
